urlConstructionMethod.linkedinFacebook: URL slug never guessed from a display name. Renders inert 'Owner URL required' status when no confirmed slug exists in local evidence.

partD_schemaExtension.newExport: mediaDestinationSchema (platform, handle, url: nullable, urlStatus enum[owner-supplied|inert-missing-evidence], linkText)

partE_publicRenderingRules.inertFallback: '{platform}: Owner URL required' plain text, never a link or button
partE_publicRenderingRules.staticOnly: astro/loaders glob() reads only local committed JSON files at build time; zero network requests

partF_alexandermathaiComBlocker.resolution: Reported as a blocker per the Mark 10 brief's own escape valve ('stop founder-site changes and report the blocker; TMI work may continue if safe'). Guard was not weakened.

partG_validation.checkConstants: 0 errors (pre-existing unrelated drift warnings only, unchanged)
partG_validation.testA11y: 0 axe-core violations across all 13 routes including /media
